goal: Compare valid continuous-block Markov inference with the optimized previous blind-gap conditional-mean method at matched evolution time

access_contract.schedule: fixed quotas; all lag1 blocks then all lag2 blocks; no adaptive routing
access_contract.detector: fixed deterministic binary function in these simulations; inference permits fresh independent endpoint noise under the same augmented mixing contract
access_contract.calibration_qualification: Envelope is structurally true for the two valid synthetic models; no universal mixing rate is inferred from their coarse records

design.baseline_selection: Before data, minimize certified old fixed-contrast one-sided halfwidth over this gap grid, with each record costing gap+common_block_duration and equal fixed quotas
design.new_allocation: Pay the initial gap once, then equal fixed quotas using all complete two-unit blocks
design.statistics: One-sided fixed contrast lower bound; reject equilibrium if its lower bound exceeds zero

models.name: metastable_equilibrium
models.initialization: fixed hidden state0 before the declared gaps

models.name: driven_ring
models.initialization: fixed hidden state0 before the declared gaps

models.name: wrong_mixing_calibration
models.initialization: stationary; isolates the incorrect mixing envelope from initial-state bias
models.violation: Actual additive spectral gap1/50000 is100times smaller than the declared lower bound

reported_metrics: equilibrium exclusion frequency or driven-model power with approximate95percent Wilson Monte Carlo intervals
certified halfwidth and entropy-rate lower bound
actual evolution time including blind gaps and unused budget
retained pair count and endpoint readout count
naive independent analysis of the identical continuous-block counts as an invalid negative control

simulation.sector_bit_continuous_blocks: Condition on the independent Poisson sector-switch path; integrate bit-flip hazard in switch-containing blocks and aggregate independent parity outcomes in constant-sector blocks by binomial sampling
simulation.ring_continuous_blocks: Independent forward/backward Poisson increments within observed and padding subintervals; cumulative phase preserves trajectory dependence
simulation.old_gap_baseline: Sample exact finite CTMC semigroup transitions for every gap, observation lag, and padding interval
simulation.crosschecks: Compare analytic semigroups and conditional parity sampler against direct transition sampling on separate validation seeds

cost_qualification: Readouts are counted separately. Their energy and duration, external mixing calibration, and preparation hardware costs are unmeasured, so a time gain is not an asserted energy gain. No physical data are used.
